subject: Request: security-linked trial subsidy for VPC POC
body:
From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@safeharborhealth.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: trial extension and subsidy for VPC POC (security gating)

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at SafeHarbor is excited about Redwood’s VPC offering. We ran the initial security review and have two gating items before we can run a week-long POC at scale:

- We need a short-term subsidy to cover dedicated capacity (the evaluation will spike GPU hours during ingestion).
- A one‑week extension on the default trial window so our security and procurement teams can finish the attestation.

I attached our procurement contact and a short vendor security questionnaire. Can Redwood provide a temporary credits package tied to our compliance review? If yes, what evidence do you need and what’s the typical approval cadence?

Best,
Asha Menon
Head of IT Operations
SafeHarbor Health
[Attachment: VendorSecurityQuestionnaire.pdf (PDF, 78KB)]

-----Original Message-----

From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 09:48:11 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: trial extension and subsidy for VPC POC (security gating)

Team — forwarding SafeHarbor’s ask. Short summary of what they need: short-term credits to cover a dedicated VPC POC and an extra week on trial. Security wants SOC2 snapshot + confirmation about data residency and audit logs retention.

Can we put together a one-time subsidy package (recommended 5000 GPU credits / 2-week trial window) that we can attach to a mutual action plan? Karthik — can you confirm commercial flexibility? Laura — can security sign off on the required evidence? Rishi — heads up for finance approver.

Thanks,
Ben

-----Message 2 (internal thread)-----
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: trial extension and subsidy for VPC POC (security gating)

Agree with Ben’s recommended approach but a few guardrails:

- Limit subsidy to a scoped POC environment only (no long‑term reserved instances).
- Require NDA and a signed data-handling addendum (they already attached the questionnaire; ask for a signed NDA).
- Provide a SOC2 snapshot and a one-page ops summary (we can redact internal ops metrics).

If we keep it time-bound and conditional on receiving the NDA + SOC2 snapshot, I’m comfortable approving. Karthik/Rishi — please confirm the financial cap (I’m thinking $10k equivalent credits).

Laura Bennett
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

-----Message 3 (internal thread)-----
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 11:05:42 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: trial extension and subsidy for VPC POC (security gating)

Ben/Laura — fine with the approach. Finance will accept a non-recoupable promo allocation for POCs up to $10k but we need to track against deal SH-2025-127 and ensure no overages are billed to the account. Rishi — can you enter the promo in the billing system and flag usage alerts?

Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

-----Message 4 (internal thread)-----
From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 11:51:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: trial extension and subsidy for VPC POC (security gating)

I’ll create a one-time promo code tied to deal SH-2025-127 for $10,000 equivalent credits and set a hard cap with daily usage alerts to the account owner. Please confirm the exact start/end dates once we have the NDA and SOC2 snapshot.

Rishi Malhotra
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

-----Message 5 (outbound to customer)-----
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@safeharborhealth.com>, procurement@safeharborhealth.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: scoped POC subsidy + SOC2 snapshot request

Hi Asha,

Thanks for the questionnaire — much appreciated. Per internal approvals we can offer a one-time promo allocation (non-recoupable) equivalent to $10,000 in GPU credits for the scoped VPC POC, plus a 7-day trial extension tied to the same POC window. Conditions:

1) We need a signed NDA (please see attached stub).
2) Please provide a SOC2 snapshot or a vendor attestation (we can accept a hosted snapshot link).
3) The subsidy applies only to the VPC POC project and will expire automatically at the end date.

Proposed timeline:
- Sign NDA and upload SOC2 snapshot by EOD Mon 5/19
- Promo enabled 5/20 — POC window 5/20 to 5/27 (7 days)

Attachments: NDAsigned_SafeHarbor.pdf (please sign and return), SOC2_overview.pdf (ops snapshot). I’ve also linked our HubSpot mutual action plan: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345

If that works, I’ll have finance enable the promo and share the usage report daily so your security team can monitor.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: NDAsigned_SafeHarbor.pdf (PDF, 34KB)]

-----Message 6 (customer reply)-----
From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@safeharborhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@safeharborhealth.com
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 10:53:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: scoped POC subsidy + SOC2 snapshot request

Ben — this looks good. We have returned the signed NDA (attached) and uploaded a SOC2 snapshot to the link you provided. Procurement confirms the 5/20 start date. We’ll monitor usage and loop in security if anything unexpected shows. Please send the daily usage CSV and the DocuSign link when promo is live.

Thanks,
Asha
Head of IT Operations
SafeHarbor Health
[Attachment: NDAsigned_SafeHarbor.pdf (signed, PDF, 36KB)]

-----Follow-up (internal update)-----
From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: trial extension and subsidy for VPC POC (security gating) — promo enabled

All — SafeHarbor returned the signed NDA and a SOC2 snapshot link. Rishi — please enable the promo 5/20 and send the first usage CSV to procurement@safeharborhealth.com and to me daily. I added the DocuSign/HubSpot links to the deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345 and https://app.docusign.com/Signing/?s=SH-2025-127

Ben
